tier_reason: Thesis section 9 states GCC 9.2.0 with -O3 -march=native on an Intel Core i7-7700K (Table 9.1/9.2 at 4.51 GHz) and the benchmark code is public in the repo at benchmarks/basic/generate_cache.cpp and benchmarks/basic/monte_carlo_pi.cpp, which run std::mt19937 and boost::random::mt19937 next to pxart scalar/SSE/AVX MT19937.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Thesis Table 9.1 (i7-7700K, 4.51 GHz, 16 GiB generated through a 16 KiB buffer): STL MT19937 9.29 s, Boost MT19937 5.79 s, pXart scalar MT19937 7.61 s, pXart SSE MT19937 2.11 s, pXart AVX MT19937 1.15 s (AVX about 8.1x faster than STL and 5.0x faster than Boost, derived from page data). Thesis text: scalar pXart beat the STL version but not Boost's; SSE/AVX are 'more than three times' / 'more than six times' faster than pXart scalar. Monte Carlo pi, 10^8 samples (Table 9.2): STL MT19937 with pXart's uniform function 0.53 s (0.72 s naive with std::uniform_real_distribution), Boost 0.33 s; pXart AVX MT19937 used as a drop-in through a cache ('AVX cache') 0.15 s, about 3.5x faster than STL (derived from page data); the 0.07 s 'AVX' figure also vectorizes the pi loop itself with AVX intrinsics in single precision, so it is not an RNG-only gain.
corrections.caveats: Numbers come from a December 2019 master's thesis (Friedrich-Schiller-Universitat Jena) stored in the repo, not peer reviewed; results appear only in the thesis PDF, not in the README. GCC 9.2 / libstdc++ only, Kaby Lake hardware, single run per configuration with no variance reported. The 0.07 s Monte Carlo figure rewrites the whole pi loop in AVX intrinsics; the drop-in RNG gain ('AVX cache') is 0.15 s vs 0.53 s. The benchmark code at HEAD (2021) may differ slightly from the 2019 thesis version. Last commit 2021-01-18.

notes: All Table 9.1 and 9.2 numbers match the thesis PDF. The SIMD MT19937 vectorizes one MT19937 state (Fog's technique), so its output matches the scalar generator rather than being a different interleaved generator. Metadata confirmed on github.com: MIT, 3 stars, not fork/archived, last commit 2021-01-18.
